_comment: Template for a vendor with no built-in preset. Copy, edit, and point
EGX_MARKET_DATA_SPEC_PATH at it. No code change is needed for any vendor
'fields' maps GMG quote fields to dotted paths inside one vendor row.
Mappable: price previous_close open day_high day_low volume turnover
trades week52_high week52_low market_cap currency quote_time.
'price' is required. Anything you cannot map is left unknown and renders
as 'N/A — data unavailable' rather than being estimated.
name: my-vendor
